title: Ecosystem sources
description: One ecosystem's roster, exported from its AWESOME-HUMANS.md. The roster stays the source of truth. The site combines every ecosystem's export with data/consent.toml to draw the source images and the montage.

version.description: The contract version. Version 1 is the only one.

sources.description: Every source in the roster's Citable and Watch list tables, sorted by id. The site rejects a duplicate or out-of-order id.

id.description: The roster id. The same person or publication has the same id in every ecosystem. house is reserved and never exported.

name.description: The display name: a person's name, or a publication's title.

kind.description: A person can have a portrait, and a publication a logo, each only with the permission data/consent.toml records.

url.description: Where to read the source: the first link in its roster row.

standing.description: The roster table the source is in.

marking.description: A reserved marking from the source's notes. Leave it out for an unmarked source.

since.description: The roster row's Since column: a year, a year prefixed with ~ when approximate, or null when the roster has a dash.

github.description: A GitHub login that suggests a portrait. It's a hint for the consent request, never permission: only data/consent.toml grants that.
